differences.title: 1. ARCHITECTURE
differences.leftDesc: Qdrant supports distributed deployments for high availability and horizontal scaling, managing shards across multiple nodes for resilience and performance.
differences.rightDesc: Chroma is designed for local development and single-node deployments, simplifying setup and integration into existing Python applications.

differences.title: 2. SCALING
differences.leftDesc: Qdrant scales horizontally by adding more nodes to the cluster, distributing data and query load to handle massive datasets and high throughput.
differences.rightDesc: Chroma typically scales vertically by increasing resources on a single machine, suitable for smaller datasets or development environments.

differences.title: 3. DEPLOYMENT
differences.leftDesc: Qdrant offers robust deployment options including Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-managed services, optimized for enterprise-level production environments.
differences.rightDesc: Chroma excels as an embedded database, easily integrated into Python apps without complex infrastructure management.

differences.title: 4. PERFORMANCE
differences.leftDesc: Qdrant utilizes advanced indexing (HNSW) and memory management for low-latency search, optimized for high-volume real-time applications.
differences.rightDesc: Chroma prioritizes developer experience, offering quick setup and integration, with performance suitable for many common AI use cases.

differences.title: 5. DATA MANAGEMENT
differences.leftDesc: Qdrant provides advanced payload filtering and support for custom quantization, allowing fine-grained control over search and storage.
differences.rightDesc: Chroma offers simplified metadata handling and automatic embedding generation, streamlining the ingestion process.

differences.title: 6. COMMUNITY & ECOSYSTEM
differences.leftDesc: Qdrant has a rapidly expanding user base, strong enterprise adoption, and active contributions from security and performance experts.
differences.rightDesc: Chroma boasts a vibrant open-source community, particularly within the Python AI/ML ecosystem, fostering rapid innovation.

differences.title: 7. BACKING & ROADMAP
differences.leftDesc: Qdrant offers both an open-source version and commercial cloud offerings, with a clear roadmap focused on advanced features and scalability.
differences.rightDesc: Chroma is a fully open-source project with a roadmap driven by community contributions and its core mission of accessibility.
